Picked (a) count logged days over (b) disable the automatic exit: hydrate.py already puts sessions_by_date in state, so the spec as written is buildable with no new read verb, no seam change and no edit outside .claude/skills/screen. (b) would also have dropped the logged-day conjunct from the clinician path, which S5 requires on both sides.

The AND was already enforced, not an OR: progression_writes is only reachable from screen.py _complete on a completed pass ending cleared, and it returns [] unless the window also holds. Verified on the clinician-yes path too, which now correctly holds the brake in fixtures/06-rescreen pass 5.
